newsitem.title: CHILE: Entel leads Chile long distance traffic.
newsitem.headline: Entel leads Chile long distance traffic.

text.p: Entel led Chilean overseas long distance phone traffic in the September-November quarter, accounting for 36 percent followed by Cia de Telecomunicaciones de Chile with 23 percent, the government said.
Telex-Chile SA long distance subsidiary Chilesat was next with 14 percent, BellSouth Corp with 11 percent and VTR with 11 percent, said the Telecommunications Secretariat.
Three smaller carriers made up the rest, it said.
Entel led domestic long distance traffic with 42 percent, followed by CTC at 32 percent, Chilesat at 15 percent, and five other carriers with no more than five percent each.
